body.p: In re Appln. Of: Lotfi B. Othmane et al. Application No.: 17/353,396

Claim 1-20 are currently pending and subject to a requirement for restriction. The Examiner has identified two allegedly distinct groups of claims: Group I, claims 1-15, directed to a system for controlling objects using brainwaves, and Group II, claims 16-20, directed to a method of controlling objects using brainwaves. The Examiner alleges that these groups are related as a process and an apparatus for its practice, and the Examiner alleges that these groups are independent and distinct because the apparatus of Group I is not required to perform the process of Group II.
Applicants elect Group I, claims 1-15, without traverse.
Applicants respectfully assert that rejoinder of the non-elected method claims of
Group II will be appropriate upon allowance of the elected apparatus claims of Group I as the method claims require all the limitations of the apparatus claims.
The application is considered in good and proper form for examination, and the

Examiner is respectfully requested to consider the elected claims on their merits. If, in the opinion of the Examiner, a telephone conference would expedite the prosecution of the subject application, the Examiner is invited to call the undersigned attorney. Extension of Time and Fee Deficiency

Applicants believe that no extension of time is required. However, this conditional petition is being made to provide for the possibility that Applicants have inadvertently overlooked the need for a petition and fee for extension of time. If any additional fee is required, or any overpayment is made, in connection with this communication please charge or credit deposit account No. 50-3505.
